# Locations & Battles

## America {#america}

America is a nation whose skippers, naval officers, and government were deeply interested in and seriously concerned by the reports of a mysterious, gigantic sea monster in 1866.

_Sources: [v1 PART ONE P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 PART ONE P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 PART ONE P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 PART ONE P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), +8 more_

**Associated with:** [Commander Farragut](../character/commander-farragut.md)

## Antarctic {#antarctic}

The Antarctic Ocean, also known as the Frozen Ocean, is one of the five major divisions into which the earth's waters are classified.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII SOME FIGURES P43](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XII SOME FIGURES P44](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0044), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P0](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P1](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0001), +5 more_

## Antilles {#antilles}

The Antilles is a region of the ocean where a sand bed can be seen with surprising clarity under seventy-five fathoms of water, and whose varieties of sea life include polypi known as "Neptune's car."

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P93](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0093), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P94](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0094), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P95](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0095), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P96](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0096), +14 more_

## Asia {#asia}

Asia is a landmass situated to the west of the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific) Ocean whose coast is skirted by the Kuro-Scivo current after it leaves the [Gulf](../codex/places.md#gulf) of Bengal and passes through the Straits of Malacca.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII SOME FIGURES P44](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0044), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P0](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P1](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), +14 more_

## Australia {#australia}

Australia is a continent off whose eastern coast the steamer [Governor Higginson](../codex/tech.md#governor-higginson) encountered a fast-moving, mysterious nautical phenomenon in July 1866.

_Sources: [v1 PART ONE P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 PART ONE P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 PART ONE P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 PART ONE P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), +4 more_

## Brest {#brest}

Brest is a French location featuring an arsenal foundry that existed around 1785, and it served as the departure point for the French merchantmen [Recherche](../codex/tech.md#recherche) and Esperance in September 1791.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P22](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P23](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P24](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025), +12 more_

## Brooklyn {#brooklyn}

Brooklyn is a location featuring a pier and quay where the frigate [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) was moored and departed on its expedition.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P15](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P16](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P18](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0018), +19 more_

## Calcutta {#calcutta}

Calcutta is a port city where Captain [Dillon](../character/dillon.md) secured support from the Asiatic Society and the Indian Company for his expedition to [Vanikoro](../codex/places.md#vanikoro), and to which he later returned before traveling to [France](../codex/places.md#france).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P27](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P29](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P30](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0030), +9 more_

## Cancer {#cancer}

The Tropic of Cancer is a line of latitude crossed by both the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) and the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) during their voyages through the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific) Ocean.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P8](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P9](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P10](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), +14 more_

## Cape Horn {#cape-horn}

Cape Horn is a solitary island rock located at the southern extremity of the [American](../codex/factions.md#american) continent that was named by Dutch sailors after their native town.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P38](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P0](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P1](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P2](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0002), +16 more_

## Capricorn {#capricorn}

The tropic of Capricorn is a geographical line of latitude crossed by the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) during its journey toward the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P8](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P9](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P10](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P11](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0011), +14 more_

## China {#china}

China is a distant country to which the servant [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) was willing to travel, and its adjacent seas served as a searching ground for the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) during its hunt for the mysterious sea monster.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P2](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P3](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P4](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0004), +14 more_

## Crespo {#crespo}

Crespo is a small desert island in the [North Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific), also recorded on old Spanish maps as Rocca de la [Plata](../codex/places.md#plata), which features underwater forests.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P15](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P16](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P17](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P18](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0018), +32 more_

## England {#england}

England is a practical nation that took reports of an unknown, gigantic aquatic creature more seriously than light-thinking people who jested about it.

_Sources: [v1 PART ONE P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 PART ONE P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 PART ONE P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 PART ONE P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), +5 more_

## Europe {#europe}

Europe is a continent whose governments, merchant and seafaring populations, and maritime captains were deeply interested in the mysterious 1866 sea phenomenon, and it forms one bound of the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic) region where the monster was sighted.

_Sources: [v1 PART ONE P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 PART ONE P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 PART ONE P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 PART ONE P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), +6 more_

## France {#france}

France is a European nation whose government attached Assistant Professor Pierre [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) to an expedition to Nebraska and later conducted inquiries into the potential existence of a submarine war machine.

_Sources: [v1 PART ONE P17](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0017), [v1 PART ONE P18](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0018), [v1 PART ONE P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019), [v1 PART ONE P20](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0020), +13 more_

**Associated with:** [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md)

## Gilboa {#gilboa}

Gilboa is an island surrounded by a coral reef and covered in dense forests of [Papuan](../codex/places.md#papua) flora, including screw-pines and abundant bread-fruit trees.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P11](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P12](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P13](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P14](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0014), +26 more_

> [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) go ashore on the island of Gilboa to harvest wild plant foods like breadfruit and coconuts. The following day, they return to hunt game, successfully acquiring pigeons, a bird of paradise, a wild hog, and several kangaroos. As they enjoy an elaborate dinner on the beach, their discussion of escaping the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) is interrupted by a falling stone.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P20](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P39](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P70](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P78](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0078)_

## Good Hope {#good-hope}

The Cape of Good Hope is a geographic cape that one might double when traveling toward [Cape Horn](../codex/places.md#cape-horn) and the [Antarctic](../codex/places.md#antarctic) pole.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P105](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0105), [v1 CHAPTER XXII “ÆGRI SOMNIA” P0](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXII “ÆGRI SOMNIA” P1](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXII “ÆGRI SOMNIA” P2](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0002), +5 more_

## Gulf {#gulf}

The Gulf of Bengal is a tropical body of water whose perpendicular sun rays heat the Kuro-Scivo, a warm, pure indigo ocean current that flows through the Straits of Malacca into the [North Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P14](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P15](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P16](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P17](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0017), +5 more_

## Gulf Stream {#gulf-stream}

The Gulf Stream is considered the most remarkable of five principal ocean currents identified by science across the globe.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P14](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P15](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P16](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0016), +5 more_

## Gulf of Mexico {#gulf-of-mexico}

The Gulf of Mexico is a body of water where a variety of trochi, remarkable for their imbricated shells, originate.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P94](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0094), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P95](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0095), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P96](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0096), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P97](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0097), +5 more_

## Havannah {#havannah}

_Not yet known._

## Indian Ocean {#indian-ocean}

The Indian Ocean is a body of water that features a principal current in its southern region, as well as an ancient or probable current in its northern region.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P14](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P15](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P16](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0016), +5 more_

## Italy {#italy}

Italy is one of several nations where official inquiries led to the rejection of the submarine warship hypothesis, and it is also the country where a inventor named Landi perfected a gun designed to fire underwater.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P5](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P6](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0006), +14 more_

## Japan {#japan}

Japan is a coastal region located less than two hundred miles from the frigate Abraham Lincoln's position in the northern [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific), and its surrounding waters host a diverse array of marine life, including unique mackerel and salamanders.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P16](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P17](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P18](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0018), +14 more_

## Jardin {#jardin}

The Jardin des Plantes is a French botanical location near Professor Aronnax's lodging and study, featuring a museum of natural history as well as animal cages where creatures like a Babiroussa can be displayed to the public.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P20](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P21](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P22](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), +23 more_

## Liverpool {#liverpool}

Liverpool is a place containing the basin of the Cunard Company where the damaged [Scotia](../codex/tech.md#scotia) entered after a three days' delay that caused great uneasiness, and it is also home to the Adelphi Hotel.

_Sources: [v1 PART ONE P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 PART ONE P14](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0014), [v1 PART ONE P15](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0015), [v1 PART ONE P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), +14 more_

## London {#london}

London is a city where Penn & Co. forged the screw shaft for the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) and where a cigar-like shape was previously adopted for similar constructions.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XI ALL BY ELECTRICITY P34](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XI ALL BY ELECTRICITY P35](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XI ALL BY ELECTRICITY P36](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER XII SOME FIGURES P0](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0000), +14 more_

## Long Island {#long-island}

Long Island is a location with a low yellow coast that was skirted by the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) before the frigate ran into the waters of the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P40](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P41](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0041), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P42](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0042), +5 more_

## Marquesas {#marquesas}

The Marquesas are a group of charming islands protected by the French flag, featuring woody mountains such as Martin's peak on Nouka-Hiva, the largest island of the group.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P15](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P18](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0018), +5 more_

## Mediterranean {#mediterranean}

The Mediterranean is a body of water with measured depths reaching 2,500 yards, and its coasts along [France](../codex/places.md#france), [Italy](../codex/places.md#italy), and Barbary produce coral that is less valuable than that found in the Pacific's coral kingdom.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P10](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P11](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P12](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0012), +14 more_

## New Caledonia {#new-caledonia}

New Caledonia is a region featuring barrier reefs created by marine polypi, which is theorized to eventually be joined with [New Zealand](../codex/places.md#new-zealand) and neighboring island groups to stretch a fifth continent to the [Marquesas](../codex/places.md#marquesas).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P27](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P28](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P30](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0030), +9 more_

## New York {#new-york}

New York is a city where Assistant Professor Pierre [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) arrived in late March following a research expedition in Nebraska, staying at the Fifth Avenue Hotel before embarking on an expedition aboard the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) from the [Brooklyn](../codex/places.md#brooklyn) pier.

_Sources: [v1 PART ONE P17](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0017), [v1 PART ONE P18](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0018), [v1 PART ONE P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019), [v1 PART ONE P20](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0020), +25 more_

> Pierre [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) arrives in New York and is consulted on the mysterious ocean monster. He publishes an article proposing that the phenomenon is an enormously large giant narwhal. Following reports of the creature in the [North Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific), [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) receives an invitation from the [United States](../codex/places.md#america) Secretary of Marine to join Commander Farragut's expedition aboard the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER II PRO AND CON

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P8](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019)_

## New Zealand {#new-zealand}

New Zealand is a region associated with the origin of the magnificent spur, a rare specimen of mollusc.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P94](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0094), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P95](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0095), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P96](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0096), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P97](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0097), +5 more_

## North Atlantic {#north-atlantic}

The region of the Atlantic lying between the [United States](../codex/places.md#america) and [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe) is a stretch of ocean where both the [Helvetia](../codex/tech.md#helvetia) and the [Shannon](../codex/tech.md#shannon) sighted a giant, mysterious monster at 42° 15• [N](../character/nemo.md). lat. and 60° 35• W. long.

_Sources: [v1 PART ONE P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 PART ONE P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 PART ONE P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 PART ONE P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), +5 more_

## North Pacific {#north-pacific}

The Northern Pacific is an expansive oceanic region whose waters, along with the adjacent [Japanese](../codex/factions.md#japanese) and [American](../codex/factions.md#american) coasts, were thoroughly furrowed and explored by the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) during a three-month search for the sea monster.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P1](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P2](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P3](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P4](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0004), +18 more_

> The party continues their undersea excursion, resting and encountering a giant sea-spider before reaching the underwater base of [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo) Island. On the return journey, Captain Nemo and his companion hunt a sea-otter and an albatross, and the group narrowly escapes two dangerous sharks before returning to the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVI A SUBMARINE FOREST

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI A SUBMARINE FOREST P11](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XVI A SUBMARINE FOREST P14](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XVI A SUBMARINE FOREST P15](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XVI A SUBMARINE FOREST P23](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0023)_

## Oceania {#oceania}

Oceania is a region featured in the voyages of [Dumont](../character/urville.md) d'Urville, noted for its coral reefs and principal islands whose hydrographical bearings he fixed.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P65](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0065), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P66](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0066), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P67](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0067), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P68](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0068), +6 more_

## Papua {#papua}

Papua is a region whose south-east point lies 750 leagues south-westerly from [Vanikoro](../codex/places.md#vanikoro) and whose coasts were sighted by the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) on January 4th.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P48](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0048), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P49](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0049), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P50](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0050), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P51](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0051), +13 more_

## Paris {#paris}

Paris is a city home to a Museum of Natural History, as well as the Museum of the Faculty of Medicine which houses a two-and-a-quarter-yard narwhal tusk.

_Sources: [v1 PART ONE P17](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0017), [v1 PART ONE P18](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0018), [v1 PART ONE P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019), [v1 PART ONE P20](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0020), +25 more_

## Plata {#plata}

Plata, or Rocca de la Plata, meaning "The Silver Rock," is a small desert island in the [North Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific) Ocean located at 32° 40• north latitude and 157° 50• west longitude, also known as the island of [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P24](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P25](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P26](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P27](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0027), +5 more_

## Prussia {#prussia}

Prussia is a nation where government inquiries were conducted regarding the mystery of a potential submarine war machine, and it is also the location of Krupp, the manufacturer that produced the engine for the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P5](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P6](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0006), +14 more_

## Quebec {#quebec}

Quebec is a town in Canada, formerly belonging to [France](../codex/places.md#france), that is home to a museum and was the original ancestral home of [Ned](../character/ned-land.md) Land's family of hardy fishermen.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P5](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P6](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P7](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P8](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0008), +14 more_

**Associated with:** [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)

## Red Sea {#red-sea}

The Red Sea is a body of water from whose pinna-marina pink pearls are harvested.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P95](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0095), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P96](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0096), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P97](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0097), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P98](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0098), +5 more_

## Rhodes {#rhodes}

Rhodes is an island that was desolated by a serpent confronted by Dieudonné de Gozon, a Knight of Rhodes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P40](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P41](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0041), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P42](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P43](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0043), +5 more_

## South Pole {#south-pole}

The South Pole is a polar region characterized by icebergs, visited twice by French navigator [Dumont](../character/urville.md) d'Urville during voyages that led to the discovery of Adelaide and Louis Philippe.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P65](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0065), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P66](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0066), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P67](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0067), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P68](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0068), +6 more_

## Spain {#spain}

Spain is one of several nations where inquiries were made before rejecting the hypothesis that the mysterious phenomenon was a submarine war vessel.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P5](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P6](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0006), +5 more_

## Syria {#syria}

Syria is a geographic region associated with soft sponges displayed among the zoophyte collection aboard Captain Nemo's vessel.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P93](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0093), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P94](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0094), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P95](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0095), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P96](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0096), +5 more_

## Torres Straits {#torres-straits}

The Torres Straits are a nearly thirty-four-league-wide passage obstructed by numerous islands, breakers, and rocks, featuring sea level differences of a yard and a half between high and low tides.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P5](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P6](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P7](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P8](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0008), +14 more_

> As the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) navigates the treacherous Torres Straits, it runs aground near the Island of [Gilboa](../codex/places.md#gilboa). Captain Nemo remains confident that the upcoming full moon tide will free the ship. Taking advantage of the situation, [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) obtain permission to take a small boat to the island to hunt for fresh meat.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P16](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P26](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P40](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P41](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0041)_

## Vanikoro {#vanikoro}

Vanikoro is a group of green, verdant volcanic islands situated at 16° 4• S. lat. and 164° 32• E. long., featuring the 476-foot Mount Kapogo, the harbour of [Vanou](../codex/places.md#vanou), and surrounding coral reefs that were the site of the shipwreck of La Perouse's vessels.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P7](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P8](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P9](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), +46 more_

## Vanou {#vanou}

Vanou is a small harbor situated at 16° 4′ S. lat. and 164° 32′ E. long. on the island of [Vanikoro](../codex/places.md#vanikoro).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P16](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P17](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P18](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P19](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0019), +5 more_
